statement.en: This level is set in Toronto, in Ontario. Discover Canada calls Toronto the largest city in the country and its main financial centre. Many people there work in service or manufacturing industries, and those industries make a large part of Canada's exports.
statement.fr: Ce niveau se déroule à Toronto, en Ontario. Découvrir le Canada présente Toronto comme la plus grande ville du pays et son principal centre financier. Beaucoup de gens y travaillent dans les services ou la fabrication, et ces industries produisent une grande part des exportations du Canada.

source.quote: Toronto is the largest city in Canada and the country’s main financial centre. Many people work in the service or manufacturing industries, which produce a large percentage of Canada’s exports.

verification.evidence: Toronto is the largest city in Canada and the country’s main financial centre. Many people work in the service or manufacturing industries, which produce a large percentage of Canada’s exports.

blurb.en: You vote in city elections as well as federal ones. Provincial, territorial and city elections also use a secret ballot, but their rules are not the same as the federal ones.
blurb.fr: On vote aussi aux élections municipales, pas seulement aux élections fédérales. Les élections provinciales, territoriales et municipales se tiennent également au scrutin secret, mais leurs règles diffèrent de celles du fédéral.

source.quote: Provincial, territorial and municipal elections are held by secret ballot, but the rules are not the same as those for federal elections.

verification.evidence: Local or municipal government plays an important role in the lives of our citizens. Municipal governments usually have a council that passes laws called “by-laws” that affect only the local community. The council usually includes a mayor (or a reeve) and councillors or aldermen. Municipalities are normally responsible for urban or regional planning, streets and roads, sanitation (such as garbage removal), snow removal, firefighting, ambulance and other emergency services, recreation facilities, public transit and some local health and social services.

blurb.en: This is the CN Tower. On election night, the results are shown on television and posted on the Elections Canada website, www.elections.ca.
blurb.fr: Voici la Tour CN. Le soir de l'élection, les résultats sont diffusés à la télévision et publiés sur le site Web d'Élections Canada, www.elections.ca.

source.quote: You can see the results on television or on the Elections Canada website (www.elections.ca).

verification.evidence: Toronto is the largest city in Canada and the country’s main financial centre.

blurb.en: This is Nathan Phillips Square. To vote in a federal election or a federal referendum, you must be a Canadian citizen, be at least 18 years old on voting day, and be on the voters' list.
blurb.fr: Voici la place Nathan-Phillips. Pour voter à une élection fédérale ou à un référendum fédéral, il faut être citoyen canadien, avoir au moins 18 ans le jour du scrutin et être inscrit sur la liste électorale.

source.quote: You are eligible to vote in a federal election or cast a ballot in a federal referendum if you are: • a Canadian citizen; and • at least 18 years old on voting day; and • on the voters’ list.

verification.evidence: More than half the people in Canada live in cities and towns near the Great Lakes and the St. Lawrence River in southern Quebec and Ontario, known as Central Canada and the industrial and manufacturing heartland. Southern Ontario and Quebec have cold winters and warm humid summers.
